Agentivity is a platform to build and run AI agents, AI teams and workflows, without writing code. You describe a need, you build what handles it, and you run it. This page explains what the product is made of, before you install anything.

## What it is for

Most AI tools answer a question. You still do the managing: you ask, you check, you correct, you ask again.

Agentivity is for work that must arrive finished. You build a solution: something a person launches to get a need handled from start to finish. For example, a solution that reads a supplier invoice, checks its figures and files it. Or a solution that writes a payment reminder and waits for your approval before anything is sent.

## The three building blocks

| Block | What it is |
|---|---|
| **Agent** | One AI specialist with a role. |
| **Team** | Several agents that work together on one request. |
| **Workflow** | Steps drawn in advance, run the same way every time. AI works only in the steps you choose. |

To choose between them, read [Choose between an agent, a team and a workflow](/docs/introduction/agent-team-or-workflow/).

## What you get when you install it

- **The engine.** The program that runs your agents, teams and workflows. It runs on your own machine or server, with Docker.
- **The Studio.** The visual editor, in your browser. This is where you build, run and follow everything. See [Find your way around the Studio](/docs/studio/find-your-way-in-the-studio/).
- **The Assistant.** A part of the Studio that builds for you. You describe what you need in your own words; it asks questions, shows a plan and builds a draft that you check and save.
- **Ready-made solutions.** Four showcases that you can import and open, to see how a finished solution is built.

## What you bring

- **A machine that runs Docker.** Your own computer, or a server.
- **An AI model.** Agentivity does not provide one. You connect the provider you use, for example Anthropic, OpenAI or Google, with your own API key. The provider bills you directly.

## Where your data is

Your agents, teams, workflows, tables and settings are stored on your machine. What an agent sends to the AI model goes to the provider you chose, under that provider's terms.

## What Agentivity is not

- **Not a chatbot.** You do not talk to one general assistant. You build specialists with a role, and you organise them.
- **Not a model provider.** You bring your own model.
- **Not a hosted service today.** The Community edition is the one you install yourself. Hosted editions are planned. See [What the Community edition includes](/docs/introduction/what-the-community-edition-includes/).
